text.text_excerpt: This is not Deanie's Seafood. Although they share a name, they couldn't be more different. Deanie's in the warehouse district is a breakfast and lunch place with great daily specials and wonderful Po-Boys. As you walk in, step out of line and read the menu posted behind the counter. This place is busy, and the workers don't seem to have patience for those that don't know what thy want. You would think this would be a negative, but it adds to the ambiance. Once you know what you want, grab a tray, utensils and place your order. The home cooked specials are always good, but this trip I wanted a Po-Boy. I opted for the roast beef and a side of baked macaroni. The lady pulled that leidenheime...

Whoever Deanie is, they are like a fantasy therapist for me. How so? If I lived in New Orleans, I would be end up eating at Deanie's almost every single day, ballooning to 300 pounds, and never having a date on Friday night. The weight gain would be attributed to my affinity for fried foods. But the lack of dates would not be due to the fact that I am fat. It would be due to my undesirable DNA. And of course, this would lead to depression and me trying to eat my unhappiness away. Preferably, at Deanie's. I spent a week in New Orleans, and I had lunch here two days in a row. Their lunch specials are outrageously delicious and cheap. For about $8, you can have their standard meal options su...
Lunches are great! Seafood Po Boys are all great. Never had bad meal. They should have more room,sometimes it gets quite crowded at lunch times.
